anya: heads-up — I see a repeating phase oscillation in KV indices during long prefill on magnet13b-int4. repro is flaky but frequent on our nightly longctx job.
karim: can you paste the exact command + minimal config?
anya: sure:
```bash
python tests/run_longctx.py --model magnet13b-int4 --seq 65536 --prefill.strategy=staggered --seed=42 --batch=1 --prefetch=true
```
anya: observed behavior: token probabilities start drifting around step ~1800, then alternate offsets every ~40 steps. KV index logs show small phase jumps.
devon: upload a trimmed log snippet so we can see the rot_phase values?
anya: pasted excerpt (trimmed):
```
[1667] prefill shard 0 kv_index=184320 rot_phase=0.00123
[1704] prefill shard 1 kv_index=184320 rot_phase=0.00456
[1741] prefill shard 2 kv_index=184320 rot_phase=0.00124
[1778] prefill shard 3 kv_index=184320 rot_phase=0.00455
```
maria: interesting — pattern looks like prefetch + shard interleave toggles a rotation compensation step. Does it happen on fp16 as well?
anya: fp16 attenuates it, but small wobble remains. int4 amplifies it.
sree: hypothesis: the prefetch worker applies rotary resample concurrently with KV stitch, leading to a race that leaves alternating phase patches. Try run with --rotary.resample=false or serialize prefetch.
anya: tried disabling resample and the oscillation drops to noise floor. Also repro fails if I insert 100ms sleep between shard writes. so racey.
karim: can someone run the branch kvcache/prefetch-serialize (PR https://rwd.co/pr/2187) against the longctx suite and compare metrics (per-token KL and rot_phase variance)?
devon: I'll kick off a run on g2-64 tonight, will run int4 and fp16, plus the baseline. I will add --kv.verify to detect any misordered indexes.
prefetch-bot: CI started: longctx-oscillation-test #452 (target: kvcache/prefetch-serialize)
anya: also added a reproducer script at gs://redwood-dev/diagnostics/rope-oscill-repro.tar.gz with seeds and the trimmed dataset.
karim: great. if this is confirmed, we should add a nonregression test for phase-stability when prefetching is enabled.
sree: agreed — test should toggle prefetch concurrency and assert rot_phase variance < 1e-4 for seq>=32k.
devon: will post results in this thread once CI finishes.
anya: thanks all — marking as blocker for magnet13b-int4 onboarding until we confirm fix. :white_check_mark:
